_README: Label id -> tarsal bone of the female, split by the male's transferred bones (scripts/vhf_split_tarsals.py). A KEY, not data.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain): the female's CT tarsal label (TotalSegmentator, free task) split by the male's separately segmented tarsals (Andreassen et al. 2023, Sci Data 10:34, doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01905-2, CC BY 4.0) transferred onto her. Derived data (scripts/vhf_split_tarsals.py).
